title: "Research areas"
subtitle: "Scientific questions and teacher education"
---

These are the lines of work that connect research and education in the laboratory.

## Organic chemistry, free radicals and antioxidants

Synthesis and characterization of nitrones and compounds of biological interest; electron spin resonance and the study of radical species.

**Track record:** RSC Advances (2020); projects FGI 42-18 and FONDECYT 3120241.

## Computational chemistry and molecular reactivity

Study of chemical reactivity through computational models, conceptual DFT and spin-polarized DFT; applications to antioxidants, inclusion complexes and coordination chemistry.

**Track record:** The Journal of Physical Chemistry A (2026); Chemical Physics Letters (2025).

## Chemical education and experimental learning

Analysis of laboratory learning, digital pre-laboratories, modeling and scientific skills in initial teacher education.

**Track record:** Educación Química (2024, 2025); MAPEX (2026).

## Technological innovation and educational resources

Development of experiences with molecular modeling, 3D fabrication and printing, and digital technology as a teaching aid.

**Track record:** Projects Science in 3D (2025) and 27-2024-EFA (2024).

## Inclusion and teacher education

Proposals and studies on curricular adaptations, teaching strategies and access to science experiences for diverse groups of students.

**Track record:** Theses and projects linked to UMCE.

See the [projects](projects.qmd), [publications](publications.qmd) and [theses](theses.qmd) to explore the associated output.
